_comment: 8d C1/D1 (issue #14/#15) 'What the Seal Kept' -- Ceria Springwalker, waiting at dungeon_approach once the gallery reopens. Canon (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Ceria_Springwalker): half-Elf [Cryomancer], leads the Horns of Hammerad, dry/professional register (character-profiles.md voice notes). Two-node recruit sequence (hub greeting -> rules briefing) ending in `horns_party_formed` on 'Let's go.' -- the ally_requires gate `vault_boss_slot`'s encounter (trapped_halls) reads, and the quest's own beat-1 completion counter (`what_the_seal_kept`, data/quests.json). hub's own text_variants then carry the party-formed line and, later, the post-victory line -- ascending order, LAST-satisfied-wins, so `vault_construct_downed` overrides `horns_party_formed` once both are true. Softlock guard: hub keeps 'Understood.' fully ungated once 'Go on.' hides.

hub.speaker: Ceria
hub.text: You're the one Olesm's paying to poke the gallery? Good. We're the ones the Guild's paying to make sure you come back out. Ceria Springwalker — Horns of Hammerad.

text_variants.text: All right. Four of us, one of you. Try to keep up.
It was guarding a door. Wonderful. I hate doors that need guarding.

rules.speaker: Ceria
rules.text: Rules are simple. Traps kill more adventurers than monsters do, so nobody touches anything shiny. That includes you.
